description: Style definitions for the PSY family. Each style defines typical tempo range, energy, and characteristic scales. v0.26.0: all NINE shipped composer styles documented (was 5 — the roast, finding #4: the data file had frozen on a younger product).

styles.name: full-on
styles.description: Classic Israeli psytrance. Driving bass, melodic leads, high energy.

styles.name: darkpsy
styles.description: Dark psychedelic. Faster, more dissonant, atmospheric.

styles.name: psytrance
styles.description: Modern classic psytrance. The straight-12/8 rolling bass at 142 BPM; rides the classic-family kit.

styles.name: goa
styles.description: Goa trance lineage — melodic minor-dominant colors at 140 BPM; rides the classic-family kit.

styles.name: techno
styles.description: Club techno at 132 BPM — mechanical groove, tighter melodic content; rides the progressive-family kit.

styles.name: trance
styles.description: Uplifting trance at 138 BPM — driving, bright, major-adjacent lift; rides the classic-family kit.
